integrity: The self-contained transfer proof and supplied exact symbolic matrix code justify the displayed formula. Direct simulation confirms finite cases but is not used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only initially primitive-three configurations on finite ring squares of length at least five; other temporal periods, transient basins, and independent validation are not characterized. title: Range-two excitation changes sparse ring resonances into exponential primitive-three populations
